subject: Trading
title: Panic and Capitulation
description: A fast breakdown of Panic and Capitulation for builders.

hook.text: The bottom of a crash isn't quiet. It's the loudest moment—maximum volume, maximum fear, maximum selling.

buildup.text: Capitulation is when the last bulls surrender off and sell at any price. They can't take the pain anymore.

discovery.text: Capitulation creates a volume spike—a selling climax. The very act of giving up is what exhausts the selling pressure.

twist.text: Buying during capitulation feels insane. But historically, the highest returns come from investing at peak despair.

climax.text: Warren Buffett invested $5 billion in Goldman Sachs during the 2008 panic. Insane at the time—brilliant in hindsight.

punchline.text: The bottom is where hope dies. And opportunity is born.

quiz.question: What is capitulation in a market crash?
options: When the last holders surrender and sell at any price
